text: [Discord #paper-sleuth Sholto David 2024-01-05] My full analysis is at https://forbetterscience.com/2024/01/02/dana-farberications-at-harvard-university/ — initial count is 58 papers. The Ghobrial Blood 2009 paper (DOI: 10.1182/blood-2008-10-186668) is the most egregious — near-entirely fabricated mouse figures. 6 of 8 pairs exceed 0.95 similarity.

[Discord #paper-sleuth Sholto David 2024-01-05] The Glimcher Science 2006 paper (DOI: 10.1126/science.1123480) has clear duplications in Fig. 1A and Fig. 6A. Retraction DOI: 10.1126/science.adp1104. I have a pixel overlay that makes it obvious.

[Discord #paper-sleuth Sholto David 2024-01-08] DFCI's internal report says 12 acknowledged discrepancies. My independent count is 47. Their number only counts what they formally acknowledged. My blog URL is the source for the independent analysis: https://forbetterscience.com/2024/01/02/dana-farberications-at-harvard-university/
